bio: Pietro is a resilient merchant sailor whose decades navigating the perilous waters between Venice and the Ionian Islands have etched deep lines of determination and caution in his weathered face. His dual Greek-Venetian heritage manifests in a shrewd pragmatism that serves him well in marketplaces, though his deep-seated mistrust of officials frequently undermines potentially profitable arrangements.
